'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Nick Culpepper LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Culpepper]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MWYHL You've Gotta Be Kiddin' Me
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
